Maya (AE): quick handoff — Solaris Health closed today. Committed: Dedicated 4xGPU + Hosted fallback. Main asks: Okta SCIM + two custom SAML claims (dept, cost_center), 2yr audit retention, optional VPC peering. Target go-live ~6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): thanks Maya. please paste contract link and any pilot notes. I'll own kickoff and acceptance criteria.
Maya (AE): contract: https://redwood.example/contract/SOLARIS-2026. Pilot: steady 95 rps, p95 ~240ms, used streaming + rerank. costs inline.
Maya (AE): flags: legal insists on 2yr retention; customer requires custom attribute mapping that we haven't validated in their Okta. tight canary timeline (week 4).
Priya (CSM): @Nina can you validate SCIM + SAML claim mapping in a staging Dedicated tenant? also confirm audit export options (S3 + customer KMS) and any compliance notes.
Nina (SRE): I can run a quick compatibility pass. Need Okta metadata or a dev admin invite. Audit export to S3 is supported; will verify KMS handshake and lifecycle rules. ETA 48-72h. If claim transforms are necessary, could add ~3 business days.
Ethan (Support): I'll open tickets: SSO/SCIM validation and audit export. will include pilot logs and link to contract; will tag eng-platform if infra changes needed.
Priya (CSM): owners/actions: - Priya: kickoff & acceptance criteria doc - Nina: SCIM/SAML findings + retention options (72h) - Ethan: create + triage tickets by EOD - Maya: send customer eng contacts and confirm peering decision. Marking Renewal_Risk=medium until retention resolved.
Maya (AE): I'll share engineering contacts and confirm peering preference today. I'll also note their ask for clearer per-route cost breakdown — logging to product feedback.
Nina (SRE): test plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) validate attribute mapping in staging 3) run SCIM provisioning dry-run 4) test audit export -> S3 w/ KMS. Posting results here.
Ethan (Support): tickets created: SUP-12011 "Solaris: SSO/SCIM validation" and SUP-12012 "Solaris: Audit export/retention". linked to eng-platform oncall.
sync-bot: calendar invite: "Solaris onboarding kickoff" Thu 09:00 PT (Priya, Nina, Ethan, Maya) :bell:
Priya (CSM): thanks team. next check: Nina to post findings by 1867001600, Ethan to update tickets, Maya to provide contacts. I'll draft acceptance criteria once Nina's report is in.
